subject: infra.connect
name: Satellite broadband market authorisation
what_would_settle_it: A licensing decision or authorisation register from the telecommunications regulator, or a ministerial statement on satellite market entry.
disposition: not probed on this run; probe capped at eight across the three units

subject: gov.protect
name: Commission nationale de protection des donnees (CNDP)
what_would_settle_it: The decree constituting the CNDP, its membership, its public register of processing, or any published opinion or authorisation.
disposition: probed 2026-08-09: no constituting decree found; the Digital Code's articles 106-113 on the Commission's composition and appointment are the only text on record

subject: gov.protect
name: Instrument governing police body-camera footage
what_would_settle_it: The arrete, protocol or CNDP authorisation governing body-camera recording, retention and access.
disposition: not probed on this run; probe capped at eight across the three units

subject: gov.legislate
name: Startup Act implementing decrees
what_would_settle_it: The implementing decrees under Loi n 179/AN/25, or the first arrete awarding the Startup label.
disposition: probed 2026-08-09: no implementing decree found; the law's own articles 3-5 defer the label, the college and the portal to decrees not yet made

subject: geopol.gulf
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Gulf-state digital investment or cooperation instrument
what_would_settle_it: A Gulf-state investment, financing or memorandum covering Djiboutian digital infrastructure.
disposition: not probed on this run; probe capped at eight across the three units

subject: gov.legislate
name: Access-to-information law
what_would_settle_it: A freedom-of-information or access-to-information act, or a bill before the National Assembly.
disposition: probed 2026-04-01: no dedicated instrument found; the 1992 law on freedom of communication is the only instrument on the field

subject: infra.connect
name: Mobile broadband affordability figure
what_would_settle_it: A national price for a data-only mobile broadband basket, from the regulator, the operator or the telecommunications union price database.
disposition: probed 2025-11-17: the annual global reference publication carries the basket methodology and global medians only; no country figure in its own text

subject: dpi.pay
name: Consumer-protection rules for digital payments
what_would_settle_it: A central-bank instruction or code provision on redress, disclosure, fee transparency or dispute resolution for electronic money and digital payments.
disposition: probed 2025-09-18: no payment-specific consumer regime found in the Digital Code or the payment-system law

subject: digital.rural
name: Digital records in rural police stations
what_would_settle_it: A deployment record, equipment list or connectivity figure for police stations outside the capital.
disposition: probed 2024-06-30: the independent evaluation of the interoperable platform gives no evidence of station-level connection or digital record capture

subject: capacity.research
name: Public research programme in digital or data science
what_would_settle_it: A university research-centre mandate, a funded research programme or a published research output in digital or data science.
disposition: probed 2026-01-30: the university strategy names research as a pillar without a digital or data-science programme in the text held

subject: tech.ai
name: Instrument governing artificial-intelligence systems in public use
what_would_settle_it: An artificial-intelligence law, decree or procurement rule, or the adopted national strategy text.
disposition: probed 2026-01-29: no artificial-intelligence provision in the Digital Code; the national strategy was still in draft
